solar_enclosure_formula.description: Unshaded outdoor metallic enclosures in southern Iraq / Gulf (1,050-1,150 W/m2 peak irradiance) experience +12C to +22C internal air rise above shade ambient.
solar_enclosure_formula.mandatory_rule: Size outdoor enclosure electronics for T_internal = T_shade_ambient + DeltaT_solar + DeltaT_internal_dissipation, or install a ventilated double-roof 316SS sunshade reducing DeltaT_solar by >75%.

records.equipment_class: LV Variable Frequency Drive — Normal Duty (4 kHz PWM)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Indoor air-conditioned E-house (<35C) preferred; if outdoor cabinet under 1,100 W/m2 solar load, add double-wall sunshade roof + closed-loop cabinet AC
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP54 cabinet with G4/F7 washable sand-louver filters (or IP55/UL Type 12 flanged heatsink)
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Install VFD in Safe Area E-house; use dU/dt or sine filter when feeding Ex db / Ex eb motor >50m cable
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Require 3C3 (IEC 60721-3-3) conformal-coated PCBs against H2S >3 ppm in Basra/Rumaila fields
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Oversize VFD by 1 frame size at 50C or 2 frame sizes at 55C internal cubicle temperature

records.equipment_class: LV Variable Frequency Drive — Heavy Duty / High Carrier (8 kHz PWM)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Mandatory indoor substation or redundant HVAC cabinet; never mount bare IP20 module in uncooled outdoor kiosk
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP55 sealed cabinet with air-to-air or redundant DX cooling unit
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Mandatory PTC/PT100 motor winding thermal trip relay certified for ATEX safety function
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: 3C3 conformal coating mandatory; tin-plated or silver-free busbar protection if H2S present
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Reduce PWM carrier to 4 kHz during peak Iraqi summer (June-September) or upsize current rating by 1.4x

records.equipment_class: MV Multilevel Air-Cooled Drive (3.3 kV / 6.6 kV / 11 kV)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: 55C ambient exceeds standard MV air-cooled drive ceiling (max 50C with derating); requires pressurized HVAC E-house at <=35C
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP42 inside positive-pressure (25 Pa) sand-filtered E-house
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Safe-area E-house outside Zone 2 boundary; purge interlock if near hydrocarbon process unit
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Activated-carbon + permanganate chemical filtration on E-house makeup air for ISA G3/GX environments
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Specify N+1 redundant E-house HVAC chillers or liquid-cooled MV drive topology

records.equipment_class: IEC 60034 LV Induction Motor — Insulation Class F (Class B 80K Rise)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Install ventilated sheet-metal sun canopy over outdoor motors to prevent +12-18C black-body stator skin gain
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP55 minimum; IP65/IP66 with Labyrinth taconite shaft seals for southern Iraq & Gulf sandstorms
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Safe Area only; for Zone 1/2 select certified Ex db / Ex eb motor (DER-MOT-EX-01)
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: C4/C5-M epoxy marine/desert paint + stainless breather drain + anti-condensation space heaters
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Specify Class F insulation limited to Class B temperature rise at 50C/55C design ambient + C3 clearance bearings with high-temp polyurea grease

records.equipment_class: Explosion-Proof Flameproof Motor (Ex db IIC T4 Gb)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: ATEX nameplate Ta range MUST explicitly state '-20C <= Ta <= +55C' (standard +40C Ta certificate is invalid at 55C!)
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP65 / IP66 flameproof enclosure with certified Ex db cable glands
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Zone 1 & Zone 2, Gas Group IIB/IIC, Temperature Class T3/T4 verified at full 55C ambient
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: 316SS nameplate & hardware; copper-free aluminum (<0.4% Cu) or cast-iron housing
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Require OEM extended-ambient ATEX/IECEx certificate (+55C or +60C Ta) + winding PT100 sensors

records.equipment_class: MV Squirrel-Cage Induction Motor (IC611 Air-to-Air / IC411 TEFC)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Solar hood over top-mounted IC611 heat exchanger tubes; prevent sand bridging in external tubes
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP55 stator compartment + Inpro/Seal bearing isolators + duplex PT100 in stator & bearings
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Ex ec / Ex pxb purged or Ex db per hazardous area plot plan
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: VPI sealed Class F/H stator windings resistant to coastal salt-fog and refinery H2S/SO2
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Order custom 55C ambient design point on OEM datasheet so rated shaft kW requires 0% field derating

records.equipment_class: Standard Industrial PLC / DCS CPU & I/O Rack (Horizontal Mount)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Standard CPUs (0..60C horizontal, 0..40C vertical) trip above 60C internal cabinet air; outdoor cabinets require shade + active cooling
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: Mount inside IP65/IP66 Rittal-class sealed field junction cabinet (zero unfiltered fan-inlet dust!)
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Zone 2 Ex ec cabinet or Safe Area marshalling room with IS barriers
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Standard uncoated modules corrode rapidly in Basra/Maysan H2S; upgrade to conformal-coated variant (DER-PLC-XT-01)
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Derate simultaneous high-density digital output loading to 70% at 55C and leave 1 slot spacing near PSUs

records.equipment_class: Extended-Temperature Conformal-Coated PLC / DCS (SIPLUS / XT / G3)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Certified to +70C internal cabinet air; allows passive double-walled shaded IP66 outdoor cabinets without failure-prone AC compressors
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP66 sealed stainless 316L or UV-stabilized GRP outdoor marshalling cabinet
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: ATEX/IECEx Zone 2 (Ex ec IIC T4 Gc) approved when installed in certified enclosure
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Full ISA-71.04 G3 conformal coating against H2S, Cl2, SO2, and 95% RH condensation
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Default specification for unmanned Iraqi wellheads, pipeline RTU stations, and desert water intakes

records.equipment_class: DIN-Rail 24 VDC Regulated Power Supply (e.g. SITOP / Quint Class)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Maintain >=50 mm top/bottom convection clearance above DIN rail; derate 2.5%/C above 50C/60C per OEM curve
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP20 device inside IP55/IP66 dust-tight control cabinet
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Ex ec IIC T4 Gc variants required for Zone 2 field enclosures
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Use conformal-coated redundant pair (1+1 diode decoupling) for critical turbine/ESD 24VDC buses
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Size redundant 24VDC supplies at <=65% nominal load so single-unit failover handles 55C cabinet peaks

records.equipment_class: Industrial UPS Battery Bank — Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) vs NiCd/LFP
records.voltage_rating: 110 VDC / 220 VDC Substation DC & AC UPS
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: CRITICAL: Arrhenius law halves VRLA calendar life for every +8-10C above 25C (factor shown is service-life multiplier!). Never place VRLA in uncooled 50C rooms
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: Dedicated HVAC battery room (22-25C) with H2 extraction fan
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Ex db/eb ventilation fan & hydrogen detector interlocked in battery room
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: For uncooled remote desert RTUs/substations, replace VRLA with Pocket-Plate NiCd (IEEE 1115) or high-temp LiFePO4
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Mandate redundant 25C battery-room HVAC or specify NiCd cells rated to +55C operating electrolyte temp

records.equipment_class: 12 kV (11 kV System) Metal-Clad Air-Insulated MV Switchgear & VCB
records.voltage_rating: 12 kV Rated (11 kV Iraqi MV Distribution, 50Hz)
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: IEC 62271-1 normal max ambient is 40C (35C 24h avg); above 40C busbar & VCB contact rise limits require continuous current derating or forced cooling
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP4X / IP54 external housing inside positive-pressure substation building; anti-condensation heaters in cable & VCB compartments
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Silver-free or epoxy-sleeved/tin-plated copper busbars where H2S >0.1 ppm prevents silver-sulfide whisker flashover!
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Upsize feeder VCB from 1250A to 1600A (or 2500A to 3150A with forced ventilation) when substation HVAC loss reaches 50-55C

records.equipment_class: 36 kV (33 kV System) Metal-Clad / Gas-Insulated (C-GIS) MV Switchgear
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Prefer SF6/Dry-Air hermetically sealed 36kV C-GIS in coastal Basra / high-dust substations to eliminate busbar dust tracking
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP65 sealed primary gas tank (C-GIS) + IP4X LV relay compartment
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Safe-area substation room with SF6/gas density monitoring relays
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Hermetic SS304/316 gas tank completely isolates HV primary contacts from H2S, salt fog, and fine silica dust
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Apply 0.88x continuous current factor at 50C and specify 31 mm/kV minimum creepage on outdoor cable terminations

records.equipment_class: LV Air Circuit Breaker (ACB, 800A-6300A) in IP54 Switchboard
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Unventilated IP54 cubicles run +10-15C hotter internally than room air; calculate ACB tap against internal cubicle air temp!
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP54 switchboard for dusty plant rooms; IP31/IP42 only in clean pressurized HVAC electrical rooms
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: Tin-plated copper busbars + conformal-coated electronic trip unit (e.g. Ekip / ETU)
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Select next frame size (e.g. 2500A ACB set to 2000A In) and verify IEC 61439-2 temperature-rise calculation at 50C ambient

records.equipment_class: Field Process Pressure / DP / Flow Transmitter with Local LCD
records.solar_radiation_enclosure_rule: Transmitter electronics rated to +85C, BUT local LCD screens turn black above +80C skin temp under direct Basra sun -> install 2mm 316SS sunshade!
records.min_ip_sand_dust_rating: IP66 / IP67 / NEMA 4X dual-compartment housing with desiccant/silicone O-ring grease
records.atex_iecex_zone_guidance: Ex db IIC T6..T4 Gb or Ex ia IIC T4 Ga (verify T-class ambient ceiling at +60C/+65C)
records.sour_gas_nace_mr0175_note: MANDATORY Hastelloy C-276 isolating diaphragms + NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 3.1 sour-service certificate on Iraqi crude/gas lines
records.mitigation_engineering_action: Order 316SS sunshade canopy + impulse-line siphon/manifold rated for process + solar thermal expansion
